entities.summary: Tyler Deron Lockett is an American professional football wide receiver. He played college football for the Kansas State Wildcats and was selected by the Seattle Seahawks in the third round of the 2015 NFL draft. Lockett has also played for the Tennessee Titans and the Las Vegas Raiders.
